summary: Just-in-time org-level GCP audit access for incident postmortem
description:
Issue summary:
Requesting timebound, just-in-time org-level GCP read-only access so SRE + postmortem team can complete the INC-5901 investigation. The goal is temporary visibility into Cloud Audit Logs, Admin Activity, Security Command Center findings, and BigQuery tables that contain telemetry and job history across affected projects.

Impact:
Postmortem remains incomplete because engineers do not have org-level visibility to correlate cross-project IAM changes and organization audit entries. This blocks RCA and next-step mitigations. No production write access requested.

Request details:
- Principals: group 'eng-postmortem@redwood.ai' (temporary) + individual SREs: Marcus Liang, Priya Nair, Lucas Moreno.
- Scope: Organization Viewer + Logging Viewer on org and the following projects: prod-core, prod-ml, prod-data. Additionally, roles/bigquery.metadataViewer on the data platform projects for query/job metadata.
- Duration: 8 hours from grant time. Must auto-expire.
- Reason: Complete postmortem for INC-5901 (failed fallback routing between dedicated pools and hosted API causing degraded latency).
- Justification: investigation requires cross-project audit timestamps and BQ job history which are gated at org-level. Security reviewed and approves timebound read access pending approvals below.

Approvals required:
- Security: Priya Nair (security@redwood.ai) - approved in Slack (#security) 2026-03-13 14:12 UTC.
- SRE lead: Daniel Park - ack required before grant.

Audit requirements:
- All access must be performed through recorded SSH/Cloud Console sessions where possible; session logs must be uploaded to the incident Confluence page.
- The identity that performs the grant must create a short-lived Google Cloud Access Approval entry and attach this ticket ID.

Timeline request:
- Earliest start: 2026-03-14 09:00 UTC
- Auto-revoke: 2026-03-14 17:00 UTC

Notes for cloud team: prefer a temporary Google group + org policy binding or grant via Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy ephemeral session tokens. If creating a custom role (rdw_jit_audit_viewer) is simpler, keep it strictly read-only and scoped to named projects + org.viewer.
procedures_for_grant: Create temporary Google Group 'jit-audit-INT-78321' with requested principals
Grant roles/viewer and roles/logging.viewer at org level, limited to observation (no iam.* or write perms)
Grant roles/bigquery.metadataViewer on projects: prod-data, prod-ml, prod-core
Configure TTL to 8 hours and verify auto-expiration via the Cloud Console or iam policy scheduler
Record the approving security message URL and attach to the grant for audit
Post a message to #sre and #security with the start timestamp, actors, and revoke time
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11 02:42 UTC: initial symptom surfaced by internal customer monitoring (latency spike). See Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/latency/overview?var-service=hosting-api
Hypothesis A: cross-project IAM change allowed fallback routing to use stale credentials - need to check org audit logs around 2026-03-10 22:00-03:00 UTC
Checked prod-core logs (limited) - missing org-level admin.activity entries; need org-level 'AuditConfig' visibility
SRE note: there is a known gap in our log sink filters for admin activity; postmortem requires reading raw Cloud Audit Logs in organization project
Link to debug query for BQ job history: bq query --project_id=prod-data 'SELECT * FROM `redwood.audit.job_history` WHERE timestamp >= "2026-03-10"'
comments: Ava Patel (Reporter) 2026-03-12 15:08 UTC: Filing this JIT access request after Security okayed a read-only window. Adding SRE for a quick approve so we can begin analysis.

Priya Nair (Security) 2026-03-13 14:12 UTC: Approved for read-only. Conditions: TTL enforced, session recording, and Slack post with actors. See approval thread: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C01234567/p1700000000
Daniel Park (SRE Lead) 2026-03-13 18:30 UTC: Acked. Marcus / Lucas to coordinate time. Please ensure the grant doesn't include iam.roleAdmin or owner scopes.
Marcus Liang (Assignee) 2026-03-14 08:50 UTC: Preparing to request admin team to create temporary group and apply bindings. Will post confirmation to #sre when active.
safety_checklist: No write or iam admin roles granted
TTL configured and verified before notifying team
Session recording enabled and uploaded to incident Confluence page
Grant request includes link to this ticket and Security approval message
Revoke procedure documented and owner assigned (Marcus Liang)
resolution: In progress: temporary group 'jit-audit-INT-78321' created by infra-admin at 2026-03-14 09:03 UTC (awaiting final role bindings)
Infra action required: apply org-level roles/viewer + logging.viewer and bigquery.metadataViewer at project scope, ensure TTL 8h
Follow-ups after investigation: remove temporary group, export session logs to Confluence, add runbook note to avoid future gated access for postmortems
If additional follow-up access needed, open a new INT ticket referencing INT-78321 and include rationale
